title: Pink Gingerbread Christmas Clipart PNG
author: Marshall Designs
description:
Add a sweet and playful touch to your holiday projects with this Pink Gingerbread Christmas Clipart bundle. Featuring adorable gingerbread characters, candy decorations, festive houses, and pastel Christmas elements, this cute watercolor-style collection is perfect for creating cheerful seasonal designs for children, families, crafters, and small businesses.
Cute pink gingerbread Christmas clipart collection
Soft watercolor-inspired details with a pastel candy color palette
Includes gingerbread girls and boys, a gingerbread house, candy cart, Christmas tree, wreath, bell, cookies, candy canes, and festive decorations
Transparent backgrounds make the illustrations easy to add to your creative layouts
✨ Perfect For
Christmas cards and invitations
T-shirts and holiday apparel
Mugs and tumbler designs
Sublimation projects
Stickers and printable decorations
Scrapbooking and journaling
Gift tags and party stationery
Social media graphics
Small business holiday products
Digital and printed craft projects
🎁 Great For
This cheerful gingerbread collection is ideal for Christmas lovers, craft creators, stationery designers, teachers, parents, and small business owners looking for cute pink holiday artwork. Use the designs individually or combine them to create charming candy-themed Christmas scenes.
⭐ What you will receive⭐
• 24 High-quality PNG images
• Transparent background
• Size: 4000 × 4000 px
• Ready for print and digital use
⭐ Note: ⭐
– You will need a computer to unzip these files and a design/editing program that supports JPG/PNG file formats to use them.
– This product is for an instant download. No physical item will be shipped to your address
– You CANNOT resell these original files on websites, marketplaces, photostocks or any other platforms!!
Thank you very much for your purchase. We hope you will enjoy our creative pictures
